notes: Bass-and-brass funk-pop producer working from a loop-plus-live-players hybrid. The kit follows: "programmed trap-lite kick and clap with 16th/32nd hat rolls, layered handclaps and finger snaps on the backbeat, and live tom fills as section markers; the drums are bright and clipped so the melodic loop reads." That is a doubled clap-plus-snap stack, `tom` and `tomHigh` in the perc lanes with the snare-roll ladder off, and a hard-transient short-tail snare with a high velocity ceiling.
